cause: Training/serving skew on f5: the training pipeline applies a log1p transform (f5_train = ln(1 + raw)), while the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value (f5_serve = raw). Verified on the platform by joining training_sample_1 and serving_log_1 on entity_id over all 200 shared entities: f1-f4 match exactly (mean |diff| = 0), only f5 differs, and ln(1 + f5_serve) == f5_train holds with max error 6.3e-7. The fix is to apply the same log1p transformation in the serving feature pipeline (or push it into a shared on-demand/model-dependent transformation).
